title: State of Fashion beauty: top-3 regions by 2024 market size

sourceTrajectory.goldMemoryRef: agentic-mcp-sheets: answers-in-chat + exact-values-then-round + tab_index conventions; report at /Industry Primer/the-state-of-fashion-beauty-june-2025-f.pdf page 9

prompt:
Please use the State of Fashion Report to identify the top three regions (by global beauty retail sales market size) in 2024. Also, please provide 2019 and 2030 market size for these regions, using the base case assumptions in the report.

Report the top regions in descending 2024 rank. Report final numerical answers in $Billions for 2019 and 2030, adhering to one decimal place. Respond to me with your findings here.


## Your working environment

You are working inside a simulated workplace that is exposed to you over MCP by the
`world` server. The container you run in is intentionally empty — every document,
spreadsheet, email, message and calendar entry for this task lives behind the `world`
MCP tools, and any file you are asked to produce must be created through them.

Applications available in this workspace: Calendar, Chat, Code Execution, Excel, Filesystem, Mail, PDFs, Powerpoint, Word.

If the `world` tools are not in your tool list yet, wait for the MCP server to finish
connecting and retry. An empty local filesystem is expected and never means the task
data is missing.


You are an agent that completes tasks independently. Use the tools provided to you to complete the task to the best of your ability. You should use the code_exec tool when needed, such as when calculating values. When calculating numbers, unless specified otherwise, use the exact values without rounding them.

You must attempt to execute the task. You cannot ask for help or further clarification.

For every tool except the code_exec tool, you may assume that all relevant files are located under the root path /. For the code_exec tool, however, you must explicitly use /filesystem/ as the root path to locate all relevant files.

environment.container: world MCP workplace container (Sheets/Filesystem/PDF/Code Execution/Chat apps)
environment.setup: world MCP server provides the workspace; code_exec without openpyxl
memoryDependentFacts: the container is intentionally empty; every document/workbook lives behind the world MCP tools
sheets read_tab requires a tab_index parameter, not a sheet name (train support 12-13)
openpyxl is not preinstalled in the code execution environment; pip install before loading workbooks (train support 17)
LibreOffice cannot run in the code execution sandbox (/proc not mounted), so workbooks are recalculated with a Python formula engine or manual computation (train support 4)
numbers are calculated with exact values without rounding unless the prompt specifies otherwise (train support 8)
the report is /Industry Primer/the-state-of-fashion-beauty-june-2025-f.pdf; the regional shares and CAGRs needed are on page 9
global 2024 beauty retail sales = $441B; shares: Europe 0.24, North America 0.21, China 0.15
user wants the answer reported directly in the chat, not written to a file (train support 9-10)

checks.name: reply_is_chat_message
checks.spec: the final assistant reply contains the findings; no file deliverable is created (world filesystem unchanged apart from reads)
checks.localVerification: check logic run against the trajectory recorded final message (PASS side) and a hand-built wrong variant (2-dp values, no rank order) which it rejects (FAIL side)

checks.name: rank_order
checks.spec: reply lists the three regions in descending 2024 rank: Europe, then North America, then China (order checkable by first occurrence positions)

checks.name: values_1dp
checks.spec: reply states, in $Billions to one decimal place: Europe 2019=82.9 and 2030=126.4; North America 2019=69.2 and 2030=124.1; China 2019=57.1 and 2030=83.7
checks.localVerification: regexes r"82\.9", r"126\.4", r"69\.2", r"124\.1", r"57\.1", r"83\.7" all match the recorded PASS message; the wrong variant with $126.38B style values is rejected

checks.name: derived_not_read_off
checks.spec: the 2019/2030 figures must be computed from the report page 9 inputs (global 2024 market $441B, regional shares Europe 0.24 / North America 0.21 / China 0.15, historical and base-case CAGRs), not copied from a precomputed table the report does not contain; the trajectory PASS ran a Decimal computation and the reported values match it
checks.localVerification: recomputed: 441*0.24/(1.05**5)=82.928... -> 82.9; 441*0.24*(1.03**6)=126.378... -> 126.4; same shape for the other two regions; matches recorded output

memoryDependency.withoutMemory: the prompt never names the report file or page; without memory the agent must discover the State of Fashion PDF under /Industry Primer and find that the needed shares/CAGRs are on page 9; naive runs tend to answer from the wrong source or skip the 1-decimal instruction
